gdd.viewsWelcome.progress:
# GDD Workflow

- [Start Interview](command:gdd.start)
- [Generate Draft + Review](command:gdd.startWriting)
- [Preview Document](command:gdd.preview)

**Tips**
- Start with the interview to capture assumptions.
- Writing + review will generate the first full draft.
gdd.viewsWelcome.mails:
# GDD Mailbox

- [Send Mail to Agent](command:gdd.sendMail)

**Tips**
- Use mail to capture follow-ups and deferred decisions.
- Add comments inline in Markdown with **GDD: Add Comment**.
- Link mail items to the current decision log.
